segments.narration: Nazis stole an entire room, wall panels and all. Over six tonnes of carved amber, crated out of a palace near Leningrad in 1941.
It took them thirty-six hours. The crates reached Koenigsberg that October and the room went back up inside the castle there.
By early 1944 the panels were in boxes in the castle basement. Then the bombers came, and the city burned. Who moves a room during a siege?
A Soviet investigator went looking in 1945 and found ash. Alexander Brusov reported the room was destroyed between the ninth and eleventh of April.
Treasure hunters still dig for it anyway. A replica, twenty-four years in the making, opened at the Catherine Palace in 2003.
